title: Ipoh Library Shelf Quest
focus: Add each place-value column without regrouping to connect thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.

quiz.context: An Ipoh library has 1432 storybooks and receives 2156 more storybooks; how many storybooks does it have altogether?
A reading team sorts 3214 books on Monday and 1523 books on Tuesday; how many books does it sort altogether?
One library room holds 2053 books and another holds 1324 books; how many books do both rooms hold altogether?

title: Penang Park Seed Trail
focus: Regroup ten ones as one ten when the ones column reaches ten or more.

quiz.context: Park volunteers collect 1456 seeds in one area and 1327 seeds in another area; how many seeds do they collect altogether?
A Penang nursery has 2318 seedlings and receives 1546 more seedlings; how many seedlings does it have altogether?
Children record 3427 steps on one park trail and 2158 steps on the next trail; how many steps do they record altogether?

title: Klang Recycling Depot
focus: Regroup ten tens as one hundred while adding four-digit collection totals.

quiz.context: A Klang recycling team collects 1762 cans in the morning and 1845 cans in the afternoon; how many cans does it collect altogether?
Two schools deliver 2654 bottles and 1783 bottles to a recycling depot; how many bottles do they deliver altogether?
A depot sorts 3871 paper sheets from one collection and 1566 paper sheets from another; how many paper sheets does it sort altogether?

title: Johor Stadium Crowd Counter
focus: Carry regrouped values through several columns when combining totals within ten thousand.

quiz.context: A Johor stadium welcomes 3687 spectators through one gate and 2548 spectators through another gate; how many spectators enter altogether?
A sports festival gives out 4876 flags on Saturday and 2987 flags on Sunday; how many flags does it give out altogether?
A stadium team checks 2598 tickets before lunch and 4767 tickets after lunch; how many tickets does it check altogether?

title: Kuala Lumpur Bus Map
focus: Split the second number to reach the next hundred first and then add the remaining part.

quiz.context: A Kuala Lumpur bus route carries 378 passengers in the morning and 145 passengers in the afternoon; how many passengers does it carry altogether?
A transport team prints 567 route maps and then prints 126 more route maps; how many route maps does it print altogether?
A station has 1486 travel leaflets and receives 137 more travel leaflets; how many travel leaflets does it have altogether?

title: School Badge Workshop
focus: Round an addend near a thousand up to the thousand and subtract the extra amount afterwards.

quiz.context: A school workshop makes 1999 reading badges and 1546 sports badges; how many badges does it make altogether?
A district has 2998 volunteer badges and orders 2317 more volunteer badges; how many volunteer badges will it have altogether?
A badge team packs 3997 badges in the morning and 1428 badges in the afternoon; how many badges does it pack altogether?

title: Community Tree Challenge
focus: Add multiples of hundreds and thousands by combining the nonzero place values.

quiz.context: Two community nurseries grow 1800 saplings and 2600 saplings; how many saplings do they grow altogether?
A tree challenge earns 3500 points in one week and 2200 points in the next week; how many points does it earn altogether?
Volunteers prepare 4100 plant labels and then prepare 3000 more plant labels; how many plant labels do they prepare altogether?

title: School Festival Scoreboard
focus: Partition the second addend into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones and add each part mentally.

quiz.context: A school festival team earns 2467 points from games and 1325 points from quizzes; how many points does it earn altogether?
Pupils fold 3582 paper decorations before the festival and 2416 more decorations during club time; how many decorations do they fold altogether?
A festival displays 1738 drawings in the hall and 3124 drawings in classrooms; how many drawings does it display altogether?

title: Melaka Library Returns
focus: Subtract matching place-value columns without exchanging when every top digit is large enough.

quiz.context: A Melaka library has 8765 books and lends out 2432 books; how many books remain in the library?
A reading challenge has 7689 bookmarks and gives away 1256 bookmarks; how many bookmarks remain?
A library stores 9548 reading cards and sends 3217 reading cards to schools; how many reading cards remain?

title: Nature Park Label Rescue
focus: Exchange one ten for ten ones when the ones digit cannot cover the subtraction.

quiz.context: A nature park prints 6542 trail labels and uses 2317 trail labels; how many trail labels remain?
Park volunteers prepare 7863 seed packets and distribute 2548 seed packets; how many seed packets remain?
A park has 8974 visitor stickers and hands out 3629 visitor stickers; how many visitor stickers remain?

title: Recycling Bundle Balance
focus: Exchange one hundred for ten tens when the tens digit is too small to subtract.

quiz.context: A recycling centre stores 7526 cans and sends 1683 cans for processing; how many cans remain?
Volunteers collect 8638 bottles and sort 2754 bottles into crates; how many bottles still need sorting?
A depot has 6419 paper bundles and loads 1876 paper bundles onto a lorry; how many paper bundles remain at the depot?

title: Stadium Seat Planner
focus: Exchange one thousand for ten hundreds when subtracting a larger hundreds digit.

quiz.context: A stadium has 6438 seats and 2924 seats are occupied; how many seats are empty?
Organisers print 7549 sports tickets and sell 3826 sports tickets; how many tickets remain unsold?
A sports hall prepares 8657 flags and gives spectators 4732 flags; how many flags remain?

title: Rail Station Map Store
focus: Exchange across zero columns carefully before subtracting each place value.

quiz.context: A rail station has 4003 maps and passengers take 1786 maps; how many maps remain?
A transport office prints 9000 travel leaflets and distributes 4567 travel leaflets; how many travel leaflets remain?
A station prepares 6004 route cards and gives out 2879 route cards; how many route cards remain?

title: Badge Target Tracker
focus: Count up from the smaller total to the larger total to find a small difference efficiently.

quiz.context: A district badge target is 4005 badges and pupils have earned 3988 badges; how many more badges are needed to reach the target?
A school challenge needs 6004 points and pupils have earned 5975 points; how many more points are needed?
A reading campaign aims to award 8002 badges and has awarded 7964 badges; how many more badges must it award to meet its aim?

title: Community Garden Supply Shed
focus: Subtract multiples of hundreds and thousands by working with their nonzero place values.

quiz.context: A community garden has 7400 seed packets and shares 2300 seed packets with schools; how many seed packets remain?
Volunteers prepare 8800 plant labels and use 3500 plant labels; how many plant labels remain?
A nursery grows 6500 saplings and plants 3000 saplings in community spaces; how many saplings remain in the nursery?

title: School Craft Stockkeeper
focus: Subtract a nearby round thousand first and add back the amount subtracted in excess.

quiz.context: A school has 5678 craft sheets and uses 1998 craft sheets for a festival; how many craft sheets remain?
A craft club stores 7891 beads and uses 2999 beads for bracelets; how many beads remain?
Pupils prepare 8642 paper shapes and use 3996 paper shapes for decorations; how many paper shapes remain?

title: Museum Display Builder
focus: Use known three-times and four-times facts to count equal groups in displays.

quiz.context: A Malaysian museum sets up 3 display trays with 9 model boats in each tray; how many model boats are displayed altogether?
Children make 4 rows of paper kites with 8 kites in each row; how many paper kites are there altogether?
A museum activity has 3 tables with 6 craft packs on each table; how many craft packs are there altogether?

title: School Sports Kit Builder
focus: Use six-times and eight-times facts, supported by doubling three-times and four-times facts.

quiz.context: A school sports team packs 6 bags with 9 beanbags in each bag; how many beanbags does it pack altogether?
A sports festival has 8 teams with 7 pupils in each team; how many pupils are on the teams altogether?
Volunteers set out 6 baskets with 6 practice balls in each basket; how many practice balls are there altogether?

title: Reading Club Fair Share
focus: Partition the total into easy multiples of three or four, then add the equal shares to divide with no remainder.

quiz.context: A reading club shares 72 bookmarks equally among 3 groups; how many bookmarks does each group receive?
A library shares 92 reading cards equally among 4 classes; how many reading cards does each class receive?
Pupils place 81 story cards equally into 3 boxes; how many story cards go into each box?

title: Nature Trail Supply Packs
focus: Find the number of equal packs by dividing exactly by six, eight, or ten.

quiz.context: Nature trail volunteers pack 156 pencils into packs of 6 pencils; how many complete packs do they make?
A park team packs 248 trail cards into packs of 8 trail cards; how many complete packs does it make?
A school packs 420 plant labels into packs of 10 plant labels; how many complete packs does it make?
